stop.reason: F-06 P1: missing mandatory stale warning after required evidence authority changes.
stop.policy: computer-qa-plan.yaml severity P1 explicitly includes missing mandatory warning; EVIDENCE_PANEL_SPEC.md section 21 requires stale status while preserving inspectability.
stop.scope: Stop further write scenarios. Read-only evidence review and authorized restoration/cleanup may continue.
stop.correction: Initial independent P2 suggestion focused too narrowly on unchanged historical calculations and safe creation denial. statusRule: PASS requires the complete applicable scenario definition. Individual successful checks, HTTP supplements, deterministic tests and screenshots do not automatically make a whole scenario pass. FAIL records observed product defects alongside unexecuted variants. BLOCKED identifies scenarios not executed because of the P1 stop; manual limitations are stated separately.
methods: Read the complete computer-qa-plan.yaml, local-qa-retest-handoff.md, original findings and repair requirements.
Independently inspect each saved image listed in screenshot-review.json; decode its format and dimensions and record its SHA256. Content, not filename, determines evidence credit.
Review browser URL, field, focus, settled-state and before/after records, keeping loading frames and manually framed screenshots distinct from automatic focus observations.
Review sanitized HTTP and independent SQL/restoration evidence for behavior invisible to the browser; preserve execution-mode and finite-disclosure-predicate limits.
Compare observed behavior against accepted architecture, build contract and evidence-panel specification. No product or historical evidence changes.

integrityAndLimits.businessHistory: Two explicit browser-created actions plus one legitimate HTTP action from the invalid historical-assignment negative premise. The third action and original failure remain intact; no deletion or retrospective negative-pass claim.
integrityAndLimits.httpLimits: HTTP supplements are not browser passes. Tenant comparisons establish status/kind/public-field/private-no-store equality and a finite known-name/value predicate, not byte-identical bodies or universal absence of disclosures. Initial invalid-draft no-store boolean did not separately retain private; artifact explicitly qualifies this.
integrityAndLimits.screenshotLimits: Loading frames, misframed amount captures, initial Viewer frames and cross-session receipt diagnostic are retained but excluded from the assertions they cannot prove. Manual alert framing is separate from automatic focus. See per-image classifications.
integrityAndLimits.historicalEvidence: Original run 20261116T041837Z and interrupted 20261116T204852Z remain reference-only; no scenario credit imported. Their preserved counts are not replaced by this run.

finalClosure.guards: All four enabled immutable/append-only guards have expected targets/functions and function bodies matching the unchanged migration. All eight database migration checksums match source. No destructive guard test was attempted during cleanup.
finalClosure.sessions: All 24 nonfixture sessions are revoked and active sessions are zero. Seven operator-ledger sessions were revoked through the trusted session service; ephemeral HTTP harness sessions were revoked by their own finally handlers. Fixed seed-session digest and revocation pattern are unchanged. No exclusive demo-session lock remains.
finalClosure.fixtures: All eight fixed-fixture table digests match the fresh baseline. All 38 public-table digests, business counts and guards for each of the three older databases match their read-only baseline attestations.
finalClosure.browser: Viewport override reset, device toolbar and DevTools closed, reduced-motion emulation disabled, inherited native 175% zoom restored and verified. Final revoked-session page denies details. Browser owner reports all owned QA tabs closed and CUA completion emitted.

Owned issuer shutdown/final runtime drain and publication/source/evidence-preservation/sanitization checks remain root publication responsibilities, outside this independent browser evidence review.

integrityAndLimits.sanitization: Independent visual inspection observed no credentials or personal paths in reviewed images; this is not a substitute for root text/OCR/metadata/private-value scan.

verdictRationale: Reproduced product defects require repair and a new approved-head retest. The P1 mandatory safety stop blocks further write scenarios and acceptance; the environment itself is available. BLOCKED per-scenario statuses identify unexecuted work halted by that stop.
